text:
Maria (support): Hey team — ACME (dedicated pool eu-west-2-prod-3) hit consistent 429s + some 500s for ~20m. Customer escalated; they report requests queuing and we didn't scale beyond min_replicas=2. Can we triage?

Ajay (eng-oncall): @Maria what's the earliest repro? any recent deploys or scheduled batch jobs? :eyes:

Maria (support): No deploys. They ran a nightly analytics burst ~19:10 UTC that pushed QPS from ~50 -> ~600. Support logs show long request queueing and clients got 429 after ~15s. No billing hold reported by customer.

Maria (support): Quick fetch of autoscaler status gave:```
autoscaler pool=eu-west-2-prod-3
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 10
current_replicas: 2
pending_provision: 6
last_scale_attempt: 1951234500
scale_errors: ["scale_up_timeout: placement delay 30s"]
```

Keisha (eng-runtime): Can you paste the cluster/k8s events for the pool? need node provisioning logs. Also which instance family do we try?

Maria (support): Pasting key events:```
Event 1951234522: PodPending for inference-deploy-xyz -> scheduling delayed
Event 1951234528: ProvisioningRequest submitted flavor=gpu-v2
Event 1951234555: ProvisioningFailure: InsufficientCapacity in zone eu-west-2a
Event 1951234560: AutoscalerBackoff: no compatible nodes found
```

Tom (eng-infra): Hm, cloud quota for gpu-v2 is at limit for that project/region — trying to allocate hit soft quota. I'll check provider console now.

SREBot: 📣 Alert: region eu-west-2 GPU soft-quota reached (project=acme-prod, type=gpu-v2). Current usage=64, quota=64.

BillingBot: No billing hold detected on customer account acme-prod. Usage billing current.

Ajay (eng-oncall): So autoscaler tried to spin up 6 more nodes but provider returned insufficient capacity -> scale stalled. Two quick mitigations: 1) increase min_replicas temporarily to 4 to give room, 2) fallback to a compatible instance family (gpu-v1) if allowed. Can we patch runtime to try fallback families automatically?

Keisha (eng-runtime): We have a fallback path but it's gated behind "flavor_compatibility" config which is false for this pool (customer pinned to gpu-v2 in their plan). Fallback violates customer's pinned hardware constraint. We can propose a short-term override if customer agrees.

Priya (customer-success): ACME confirmed they pinned to "nvidia-a100" flavor because of perf needs. They're willing to accept a temporary override to get production back, but need SLA credit + explanation.

Maria (support): Tried scaling min_replicas=4 now as a temporary measure, applied at 1951234578. After the bump we saw 2 extra warm nodes come up and 429s dropped within ~90s. Customer reporting traffic smoothing now.

Tom (eng-infra): Provider console shows fragmentation — enough raw GPUs overall but not the requested shape in that AZ; new nodes are queued in other AZs with longer boots. Opening quota request with provider now; also filing capacity advisory.

Keisha (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler attempted concurrent bulk provisioning of single-family nodes → provider placement latency + AZ fragmentation → scale_up_timeout. When that happens, our runtime didn't offer cross-family fallback due to customer's pin. We should add: 1) better placement retries with exponential backoff and cross-AZ attempts, 2) an opt-in emergency fallback policy for customers with SLA opt-out.

Ajay (eng-oncall): Action items: Tom to follow up with provider and request AZ capacity; Keisha to draft fallback flow + config flag; Maria/Priya to confirm customer signoff for temporary override + SLA note; Jen to prepare internal incident ticket and KB. I'll own postmortem.

Jen (support-mgr): Thanks all. Please add short repro steps so ops can run a dry-run. Maria can you add the curl sample we used?

Maria (support): Repro (simulates burst):```
for i in {1..700}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://eu-west-2.prod.redwood/infer 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"prompt":"echo hi","max_tokens":32}' &
done
wait
```
Notes: run from a host outside provider network to avoid warm-cache artifacts.

SREBot: Incident created: INC-195123 (priority P3). Linked to this thread.

Tom (eng-infra): Update: provider accepted capacity request but ETA 3-6h. I'll escalate if needed. Also testing cross-family placement; initial tests show ~30-40% faster placement if we allow gpu-v1 fallback.

Priya (customer-success): ACME accepted temporary override to gpu-v1 for 2 hours. Confirmed reduced error rate. They requested a short writeup explaining the steps once stable. :thumbsup:

Keisha (eng-runtime): Will prepare a PR for an "emergency_fallback" flag and a runtime knob to reduce initial scale batch size (so we avoid bulk placement thrash). Posting draft in eng-runtime channel in ~2h.

Ajay (eng-oncall): Good. Recommend we also add telemetry for "scale_attempts -> placement_failures" so we can alert before customer-facing errors.

Jen (support-mgr): I'll draft the customer message and SLA note. Closing loop once postmortem ready. Thanks everyone :rocket:
